instruction: Open GitKraken and create a repository at ~/Documents/gk_tag_repo; add version.txt with "0.1", commit it, then create an annotated tag "v0.1.0" on HEAD with message "initial release".

verification.condition: Verify that git -C ~/Documents/gk_tag_repo cat-file -t v0.1.0 returns "tag" and git -C ~/Documents/gk_tag_repo rev-parse v0.1.0 equals git -C ~/Documents/gk_tag_repo rev-parse HEAD.
verification.expected_result: An annotated tag "v0.1.0" exists in ~/Documents/gk_tag_repo and points to the current HEAD commit.
